posts.zh:
dsh-zotero 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。通过 Zotero 本地 API（无需 API Key）操作文献库：检索条目/分类、读元数据与摘要、列附件、读全文（缓存未命中时现场解析 PDF）、下载 PDF、管理笔记。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-71d202856411a800c6a9.html
posts.en:
dsh-zotero is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Zotero library tools via the local API (no API key): search items/collections, read metadata and abstracts, list attachments, read full text (parses PDFs on the fly when Zotero cache misses), download PDFs, and manage notes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-71d202856411a800c6a9.html
